title: Contribution Workflow
desc: How to propose changes to the project.
lede: Contributions follow a simple fork-and-PR flow with focused, reviewed changes.
body:
At a glance
  • Fork & pull-request workflow.
  • Squash-merge, focused PRs.
  • Review expectations.

The flow

Fork, branch, and open a pull request. Keep PRs focused on one change; they're squash-merged to keep history clean.

Review

Expect review on correctness, scope, and tests. See Testing & Verification and Repository Agent Rules.
